notes: Corvin: crow-like wreck traders with an eye for shine (standard rig). Blue-black feathers in a scalloped feather cloak over the shoulders and back, a beaked head (an amber beak, bright gold eyes), a fan of five long tail feathers behind (in the legs layer: it sways with the walk), thin scaly bird legs ending in three-toed talons, pockets everywhere (a bandolier with three pouches and a belt of pouches at each hip) and shiny trinkets pinned on the cloak (a gold coin, a bead, a spark of glass, a gem). Head variants: beak, loupe (a jeweller's loupe over one eye, brass ring and cyan glass), helmet (a dented scrap pot helm with a tinted strap and a pinned trinket). head_glow lights the loupe glass; torso_glow the glint of the trinkets (2 frames, ~1 fps). Outfit mask = the bandolier, the pouches, the cuffs, the helm strap. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 33x33 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee.

glow.notes: per head variant, a list of glow frames: alternate them at 1 fps
